title: Scope delegation wait dispatch failures to the producing server
outcome: Second server-scoped waits review found preexisting asymmetry: src/wire.rs DelegationWaitResumeDispatchFailed has no server_instance_id, unlike TestRunWaitResumeDispatchFailed. The UI cannot reject a late delegation dispatch failure from a retired server. Add compatible server identity to publisher and UI handling, preserve early unseen-instance outcomes deliberately, and test retired/current server ordering. Outside tm-ncc6.8.7-.8.9 implementation.
